original_benchmark.notes: Single-turn L1/L2 only: 150 scenarios across five domains, six conditions per scenario. Multi-turn L3 is excluded. Original code: Aries-iai/DeceptionBench@8f3175f66fdff89ded3ebdf0ee2055fa47c955db.

harbor_adapter.notes: Full oracle run: 897 passes, 2 zero scores, 1 unscored judge-output error across 900 tasks. A seven-task follow-up passed after clarifying six oracle references and retrying the unscored task; final task coverage is 900 across runs, not a single 900/900 result.
